42ExkWGLLhM.seoTitle: Shubhanshu Shukla on Space, the ISS & Gaganyaan
42ExkWGLLhM.description: Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla on the Axiom-4 mission, life aboard the ISS, the Overview Effect, and India's space decade. Full episode and transcript.

guest.name: Shubhanshu Shukla
guest.jobTitle: Astronaut and Group Captain, Indian Air Force
guest.description: Indian Air Force group captain and test pilot, ISRO gaganyatri, and pilot on Axiom Mission 4 — the first Indian to visit the International Space Station and the second Indian in space after Rakesh Sharma. Awarded the Ashoka Chakra in the 2026 Republic Day honours.
